replace only texture 4 in isolated replays with a preregistered finite one-pixel BGRA8 source and require independently verified path sensitivity

nonvacuity.alphaRequirement: the finite-source alpha-oracle RGBA16Float trace must contain at least one nonzero binary16 alpha, R=G=B at every pixel, and output alpha exactly 1 at every pixel
nonvacuity.positiveControlRequirement: each Apple pipeline under each matrix case must change at least one independently read destination byte and pixel before candidate equality is evaluated

alphaIsolation.interpretation: on opaque black RGBA16Float the red channel is the exact current-function highlight alpha consumed by the independent candidate

independentCandidate.rasterization: full-target three-vertex triangle with integer pixel reads
independentCandidate.matrixArithmetic: nested binary16 fused multiply-add in the already recovered channel order

promotionRule: Only a validator pass over both exact current functions, fourteen nonzero Apple destination controls, and fourteen complete zero-unequal-byte independent comparisons may close the last Apple construction question. A pass authorizes the next Walle-shaped physical Retina transfer gate, not production parity or a shader change. A failure identifies either transport, current-function activity, or a concrete arithmetic mismatch and cannot be rounded, fitted, excluded, or relabelled.
